messages:
mira (sec-eng): quick triage — we ran the audit event sweep this morning and found inconsistent coverage across services (api-gw, auth, console, billing, runtime). can we map gaps and pick backlog owners?

alex (platform): saw that. i pushed a diff for the proposed schema normalization:

alex (platform): ```json
{
  "event_type": "user.login",
  "actor": { "id": "user:123", "role": "admin" },
  "target": { "service": "console", "id": null },
  "outcome": "success",
  "meta": { "request_id": "%REQ%" }
}
```

alex (platform): this enforces actor/target/outcome + request_id. still open: KMS key reference for encrypted audit blobs.

dario (infra): @mira @alex on KMS — runtime and billing already log encrypted blobs to s3 with key arn:aws:kms:... but we don't surface key_id in the event meta. ops needs that for customer validations.

mira (sec-eng): agree. customers want a mapping so when they ask for audit proof we can say which key was used without leaking key material. suggestion: add "kms_key_ref" (ARN) to meta, optional.

sasha (product-sec): +1. product teams will want a human-readable reason field for console RBAC changes (e.g., role_grant, role_revoke) so downstream compliance exports are clearer.

tz (eng-sre): runtime gap: model-serving runtime emits only user and model id, not route or served_variant. that breaks replay for intent-based investigations. i'll add a small shim to include route and model_variant in meta.

mira (sec-eng): good. for prioritization — i'd like to split by customer-facing vs internal audit consumers. propose triage matrix:
- P0: events needed to validate customer audit requests (auth.login, iam.role_change, billing.invoice_change)
- P1: investigatory enrichment (model_variant, request_route, kms_key_ref)
- P2: perf/observability (latency_buckets, node_id)

alex (platform): can we get quick owners? i volunteer to own the schema PR and console changes (P0/P1).

dario (infra): i'll own KMS meta + s3 blob lineage (P1).

tz (eng-sre): runtime enrichment (P1) — i'll allocate a few hours in next sprint.

sasha (product-sec): i'll draft the user-facing validation checklist so support knows what to surface during audits.

mira (sec-eng): excellent. action items:
1) alex: open schema PR with kms_key_ref optional + example payloads (due EOD Tue)
2) dario: add key_ref propagation from KMS pipeline + test vectors (due Thu)
3) tz: runtime shim to include route/model_variant + end-to-end test (due next Wed)
4) sasha: customer audit validation doc draft and API for requesting audit bundles (due Fri)

mira (sec-eng): also, small note on RBAC changes — console should emit pre_change and post_change snapshots for any role edits. otherwise we can't prove who had which perms at a given time.

alex (platform): noted. will add pre/post snapshots for role_change. may require 10% more payload size but worth it.

audit-bot: automated check: schema PR #421 failed json-schema validation for event.meta.request_id on console service. details: missing required property 'request_id'.

alex (platform): thanks audit-bot — i'll patch.

mira (sec-eng): final: when you post PRs, add the test command we can run locally: `scripts/audit_test --service console --event role_change`. makes reviews faster.

dario (infra): +1. also adding a small sample export endpoint for customers to download signed audit bundles (S3 presigned + KMS envelope) — i'll draft in the infra backlog.

sasha (product-sec): i'll coordinate with legal on what we can expose in the signed bundle (key ARNs ok, key material not).

mira (sec-eng): thanks all — i'll consolidate owners into the security backlog and tag tickets with customer-impact label. will follow up with quick sync if PRs land. :thumbsup:
